Un intruso raramente ottiene tutto al pr: An intruder rarely gets everything on the first access. To stay after a reboot or a password change they use persistence; to avoid antivirus, EDR and analysts they use evasion. Every mechanism leaves a trace (a registry key, a service, a scheduled task) and every evasion attempt produces signals that monitoring can collect.
Le schede descrivono cosa fa ogni tecnic: The cards describe what each technique does and how to recognise it, not how to perform it.
